threshold_rationale: Tiered, register-aware absolute cosine cut-offs. Cross-lingual (EN↔ID) and cross-register (narrative↔statute) pairs receive lower cut-offs because MiniLM cosine similarity is systematically lower for them at equal topical relevance. Values are validated in validation.py (precision/recall/F1 + inter-annotator agreement).
coverage_rate_definition: connected_incidents / total_incidents * 100, where an incident is "connected" iff it has >=1 governs edge to a regulation.
provenance_note: Auto-generated by builder.py. Incidents are REAL & sourced (see data/incidents/indonesia_incidents.json); regulation nodes are extracted from PDF statutes/standards in data/regulations/.
